name: Daily Settlement Reconciliation
description: Operations analyst compares LedgerLink end-of-day totals against MemberCore account movements and investigates breaks before next-day open.
notes: Breaks over 5000 escalate to the controller

name: Quarterly Access Review Sign-Off
description: Department heads attest that MemberCore user access lists match current staffing. Performed on spreadsheets because the platform lacks an access recertification module.

name: Manual KRI Spreadsheet Update
description: Risk analyst keys branch loss figures into a tracking spreadsheet that mirrors RiskRadar because branch managers distrust the dashboard refresh.
notes: Candidate for retirement once RiskRadar refresh is trusted

name: Branch Incident Log Transfer
description: Branch coordinators re-key incident entries from BranchFlow into OpsBoard because the two systems have no integration.

name: Legacy Archive Retrieval
description: Only one compliance officer knows the ArchiveVault folder conventions needed to retrieve pre-2012 records for audits.

name: Vendor Invoice Exception Review
description: Accounts payable reviews vendor invoice exceptions flagged in OpsBoard and posts manual correcting entries to LedgerLink.
